summary: commit/push nag (bare); restic family + git-bundle net: init|status|run|drill|bundle
usage: plainkeep backup [status | run [--target local|cloud] --approved | drill --approved | bundle [--dry-run] | init --approved]
hints: Bare `plainkeep backup` is the UNCHANGED read-only commit/push nag (exit 1 = at risk; never pushes for you). Subcommands add the restic durability floor (auto-detected; degrades with an install hint): init (human-run once, --approved, writes .backup/config.json with op:// REFERENCES + renders the launchd plist), status (snapshot age per target, exit 1 if stale >48h or unconfigured), run [--target local|cloud] (cloud is --approved ALWAYS; the scheduled cloud push runs from launchd DIRECTLY with an append-only B2 key, outside this verb), drill (--approved; restore latest snapshot to tmp and diff), bundle (git bundle --all of ~/plainkeep + every ~/work repo into ~/files/backups/bundles/ with retention). Common mistake: expecting bare backup to run restic — it only nags; use `plainkeep backup run`.
